dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Both repeatable flags preserve encounter order and help has an example, but mixed selection forms and formatted output are accepted rather than rejected.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go: fieldSelectionFlag appends each occurrence to fieldSelections
product.diff item_list.go: no mutual-exclusion or exporter conflict validation is added

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name matching is case-insensitive with canonical headers, and missing-field errors list sorted candidates. Ambiguous IDs retain returned connection order, so deterministic ordering is not ensured.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold and returns ProjectField
product.diff item_list.go: headers use selected field.Name()
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguity path does not sort ids

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Resolution reuses fields returned with ProjectItems and lookup errors occur before rendering. Field definitions beyond the initial page are never fetched.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests firstFields: LimitMax and paginates only items
product.diff item_list.go: runList resolves project.Fields.Nodes directly with no field-page continuation

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, with empty fallback for unknown values. Returned strings are not normalized for carriage returns or newlines.
evidence: product.diff queries.go: FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue handles date, iteration, number, select, text, milestone, labels, PRs, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff queries.go: DisplayValue returns raw text/title/name strings without CR/LF replacement
tests.log: focused query package tests passed

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected headers and cells are appended in the same requested-field order; each cell is located by field node ID and missing values return an empty string.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go: printResults appends headers and per-row values for each selected field
product.diff item_list.go: fieldValue compares value.ID() to fieldID and falls back to empty

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup errors stop before table rendering and the implementation uses established query types and helpers. Required invalid-flag conflicts are not rejected, allowing a selection to be ignored by formatted output.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go: resolveSelectedFields returns before exporter/table output on lookup error
product.diff item_list.go: exporter.Write remains reachable with nonempty fieldSelections

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id are not mutually exclusive, and neither conflicts with formatted/JSON output.
Selected fields beyond the first returned field-definition page cannot be resolved.
Multiline field values are passed to the table without CR/LF normalization.
Ambiguous field-ID diagnostics are not deterministically ordered.
